PALLIATIVE CARE TEAM - FAMILY MEETING RECORD
St Aldhelm's Community Hospital, Lavender Ward

Patient: ASHWORTH-LYLE, Winifred ("Winnie")   DOB: 21.06.1933 (93-year-old)
NHS No: 485 777 3456   Hosp No: RXH-0049217
Home address: Flat 3, 17 Chapel Row, Harrogate HG2 7QE
Meeting: 14/10/2026, 14:30, relatives' room

PRESENT
- Dr Oluwaseun Adeyemi-Clarke, palliative medicine registrar (chair)
- Sr Bryony Keast, ward manager
- Revd Iwan ap Gruffydd, hospital chaplain
- Desmond "Des" Ashworth, son, LPA for Health and Welfare - 07700 900412, des.ashworth@fastmail.co.uk
- Mrs Hilary Wood, daughter
- Siobhán Ní Bhriain, granddaughter (teaches at Rossett Acre Primary School), by phone
- Apologies: Dr Hodgkin, GP, Beechwood Surgery

BACKGROUND
Classical Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis, diagnosed March 2019; relapsed Sept 2025, Ann Arbor stage IIIB, Reed-Sternberg cells on cervical node biopsy. Stopped ChlVPP after two cycles at her own request. Admitted 2nd October with drenching sweats, Pel-Ebstein pattern fevers and breathlessness from a right pleural effusion; increasingly drowsy over the last 3/7. AKPS 30, phase deteriorating. Obs today BP 96/58, HR 104, SpO2 91% on air. Hb 78 g/L.

DISCUSSION
1. Understanding: Des and Hilary accept the lymphoma is no longer treatable and that prognosis is likely short weeks, possibly days. Siobhán asked about a repeat pleural drain; Dr Adeyemi-Clarke explained it would be for comfort only and is not currently advised.
2. Resuscitation: DNACPR completed 05/10/2026 and recorded on the ReSPECT form. Family in agreement.
3. Advance directive: ADRT made with Dr Hodgkin in Sept 2024 refusing CPR, ventilation and artificial nutrition, scanned to record. LPA registered, OPG ref 7000-4412-0938.
4. Preferred place of death: Winnie stated in her ADRT that she wished to die at Wharfedale Light Hospice, where she volunteered in the charity shop on Kingsbridge Lane for many years after retiring as a seamstress. Hilary would have liked her home but supports this. Referral made via www.wharfedalelight.org.uk/refer on 15/10/26; bed manager (01423 555 0274) expects a bed within 1/52.
5. Spiritual care: lifelong Methodist, Grove Road Methodist Church. Revd ap Gruffydd will offer prayer today; family asked that her own minister, Revd Pauline Ackroyd, visit before transfer.
6. Symptoms: CSCI via syringe driver, morphine 10 mg + midazolam 10 mg / 24 h; PRN glycopyrronium for secretions; mouth care 2-hourly.

ACTIONS
- Hospice transfer by ambulance once bed confirmed (Sr Keast)
- Letter to Dr Hodgkin (felicity.hodgkin@nhs.net)
- Des is first contact at any hour

Dr O. Adeyemi-Clarke, GMC 7741206

dialogue:
[doctor] good afternoon everyone , thank you for coming . i'm doctor naidoo from the palliative care team , this is sister dube , and pastor botha from the uniting reformed church in kuils river . mr mthembu asked that we all meet today .
[patient] call me bra lu , doc , everybody does .
[doctor] okay , bra lu . can the family introduce themselves ?
[wife] i'm nomsa , his wife . we've been married forty-one years .
[daughter] i'm precious , the eldest . our son lucky is driving down from joburg on friday .
[patient] i've been lucky , hey . forty-one years with this woman .
[doctor] so , as you know , the cancer at the top of the right lung has spread to the bones , and since you fell in the shower on the eighth of october you've had broken ribs on the right side . the pain is better on the morphine , but you are sleeping more and eating very little .
[wife] he turned sixty-one in august . i thought we had more time .
[doctor] i understand . we think the time is now likely weeks rather than months . bra lu , have you thought about where you want to be ?
[patient] home . not bellville . my father's place in qumanco , near ngcobo . i must speak to the ancestors there .
[daughter] dr stokes said the hospice can help in the eastern cape ?
[doctor] yes . st benedict's hospice will link with the home-based carers in ngcobo . precious , i'll email the referral to precious.mthembu@webmail.co.za .
[chaplain] and we can pray together before the journey , mr mthembu .
[patient] yes , pastor . and no machines . i signed that paper in june 2025 .
